verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Sift's general fraud-scoring, workflows, and abuse-type products (payments, account abuse, ATO, content, promo abuse) but contains no mention of distinguishing legitimate AI/agentic buying agents from malicious bots, or any agentic-commerce-specific detection capability. This is a plausible axis for a fraud platform to address, but nothing in the docs or community evidence shows Sift addressing AI agent traffic classification specifically. missing for 10: any documentation or mention of AI-agent/bot differentiation, agentic-commerce signals, or policies preventing blanket-blocking of AI buying agents.
